title: Acid Crown
body:
Acid Crown

The Acid Crown is a quest item and equipment item dropped exclusively from the Skeleton King located in his arena near the back of the Acidlands. It serves no purpose other than to complete the Goblin arena Quest to start the trial.

Similar to that of other worn equipment items like the Miners Helmet or Refined Scooba Tank, it can be worn and seen on the players avatar when equipped.

After you complete the Goblin arena Quest, you won't be needing to wear acid crown anymore in order to enter the goblin shops. As well you can rematch the arena without using the acid crown.
